title: Divergence Liftings and Regular Factorizations for Metric Cotype
summary: The least regular norm of a factorization of antipodal differences through sign differences on \((\mathbb Z/m\mathbb Z)^n\) is \(m/2\) when \(4\mid m\). On these tori, when \(2\sqrt n\le m\le4\sqrt n\), normalized divergence equations admit selections with pointwise norm bound \(3/2\), while the least linear lifting norm and global Lipschitz selection constant equal \(\sqrt n/2\). Higher-moment lifting bounds follow from a quoted sharp \(L_1\) inequality.
